relationships.subject: IL-1RA
relationships.evidence_quote: Pain was reliably reversed in both male and female rats, indicating no sex difference in the effectiveness of intrathecal IL-1RA to reduce neuropathic pain

relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: CCI surgery significantly increased NLRP3 mRNA levels in microglia (Figure 7A) and in astrocytes (Figure 7B) compared to contralateral spinal cord

relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: CCI significantly increased IL-1beta mRNA levels in microglia in both sexes compared to contralateral spinal cord

key_findings: CCI increased NLRP3, NLRP1, NLRC4 and AIM2 mRNA in dorsal spinal cord of both sexes, with NLRP3 and AIM2 higher in females and NLRP1 higher in males.
NLRP3 rise was in microglia and astrocytes, not neurons; IL-1beta rise was microglial; intrathecal IL-1RA reversed allodynia in both sexes.
